rename.from: Regression: NullPointerException in PermitAllInterceptor when running test

body:
This is kind of a weird use case (I mean injecting the Resource into the test), but the fix is really easy nonetheless.

@kenfinnigan do you want to fix it or should I?

> This is kind of a weird use case (I mean injecting the Resource into the test), but the fix is really easy nonetheless.

I did try to condense the example to the minimum, so that may make it look a bit strange. But I would still be interested in what you consider weird here.

> I did try to condense the example to the minimum, so that may make it look a bit strange. But I would still be interested in what you consider weird here.

Oops. I missed the edit there after the email notification. But in a `@QuarkusTest` I would have expected this to be fairly normal way to test a service, when not interested in the serialization / deserialization aspects.
It's weird to inject a JAX-RS in a test class. Not wrong, just weird :)
If a test isn't testing the serialization/deserialization but just the pure method processing, would the preferred approach be just to `new` the class and call the method?

issue.title: Prevent possible NPE in QuarkusRestPathTemplateInterceptor
issue.body:
This can happen if a JAX-RS Resource is injected into a test
and invoked in it.

Fixes: #18146
